pages.text: $(italic)Hybrid multiclass. Benefits from breadth. Jack of all trades, rewarded for variety and exploration.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: +5%  |  Equipment HP: Normal$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$() No penalties on anything

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Adaptable$() — Every 30 min of playtime: +1% to a random stat (max 10 stacks). Stacks persist through death.$(br2)$(bold)Worldly$() — +5% damage in any dimension spent 30+ minutes in. Stacks across dimensions — a $(thing)Wanderer$() who's explored everywhere is the most consistent damage dealer late-game.$(br2)$(bold)Resourceful$() — +15% XP gained, +10% loot quantity. The passive income class.

pages.title: Passive Abilities (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Jack of All Trades$() — Wearing armor from 2+ different material types: +5% all stats per unique material (max +20% at 4 types).$(br2)$(bold)Survivor$() — +25% reduced death durability penalty. +20% reduced anvil repair costs.

pages.title: Active Ability
pages.text: Active: $(bold)Improvise$()$(br)Gain a random buff for 15s: +30% damage, +30% speed, +30% DR, +50% crit, Regen III, or Invisibility. 45s cooldown.
